name: vrsPositionOfCM
description: Longitudinal location of the center of mass in percent of MAC. Reference location is 35%.

name: referenceWingChord
description: Mean aerodynamic chord, needed for center-of-mass calculations

name: bodyMomentOfInertia_Roll
description: Rolling moment of inertia about the body X axis

name: bodyMomentOfInertia_Pitch
description: Pitching moment of inertia about the body Y axis

name: bodyMomentOfInertia_Yaw
description: Yawing moment of inertia about the body Z axis

name: bodyProductOfInertia_ZX
description: Cross-product of inertia in the body X-Z plane

name: bodyProductOfInertia_XY
description: Cross-product of inertia in the body X-Y plane

name: bodyProductOfInertia_YZ
description: Cross-product of inertia in the body Y-Z plane

name: bodyPositionOfCmWrtMrc_Y
description: Lateral location of the center of mass relative to the plane of symmetry (0 BL), positive if the CM is right of the X-Z plane.

name: bodyPositionOfCmWrtMrc_Z
description: Vertical location of the center of mass relative to the bottom of the flat part of the belly, positive if the CM is below the waterline of the vehicle.

name: bodyPositionOfCmWrtMrc_X
description: Longitudinal location of the center of mass relative to the moment reference center (35% MAC), positive if the CM is forward of the MRC. Calculated as (35 - CG_PCT_MAC)*CBAR/100.
